footprintSource.independenceNote: This is an external footprint cross-reference for spatial triage, not survey-grade independent truth and not proof that an elevated point cluster belongs to the photographed building.

query.metricCrsRationale: NAD83 / UTM zone 15N, suitable for local distance and area comparisons near the source sample in Minnesota.

outputPolicy.purpose: Short-lived, release-pinned footprint match candidates around the EPT elevated-return components.

limitations: The EPT elevated-return components are represented by axis-aligned bounding boxes, not actual roof or building footprint polygons.
Overture footprints can be roofprints and are conflated from multiple sources; they are not asserted to be survey geometry.
EPSG:26915 distances are local projected map distances, not a geodetic survey accuracy claim.
A candidate footprint spatially close to an EPT component does not establish visual identity or image-to-object correspondence.
The camera GPS coordinate is the camera centre, not a surveyed building control point; source camera altitude is excluded due to unknown vertical datum.
No engine-generated candidate GLB, independent held-out checkpoints or building accuracy metrics are created by this task.
